title: NIST WebBook: Water triple-point pressure
summary: The WebBook lists 1 triple-point pressure row(s) for Water. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook triple-point pressure rows for Water (CAS 7732-18-5) print: 0.0061 bar, method N/A, reference Sato, Watanabe, et al., 1991, comment: Uncertainty assigned by TRC = 1.×10 -7 bar; TRC (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
